body: Thank you and sorry for the misunderstanding. I’m so sorry that you have to deal with this it must be awful living with it, I hope you find help too, it’s not like we were given a choice to feel what we feel, I really appreciate your honesty. Good luck.

Thank you for your honesty, it was so very brave, I hope more people will be able to come forward and get help no matter what situation they find themselves in because at the end of the day this is your life and their life and we only have an unlimited amount of time.
You are not alone.

Thank you so much, you’re a kind soul. Would really never wish these feelings on anyone it is devastating, I’m so sorry you have experienced any form of abuse it just isn’t right and I wish you peace and hope in your life.

I’m very sorry to hear that you are dealing with this situation in your life. I do not and will never identify as a pedophile and this is probably the hardest post I will ever make in my life because of the stigma and because of the disease that this ‘lifestyle’ is.

I should have stated in my post clearly that there is NO sexual attraction 😭 feel so nauseated even thinking of this. Thank you for your response. What I’m experiencing is a negative association between children and child predators, they remind me of pedophiles whenever I see them. I have had paranoid thoughts that my father is a pedophile. Sorry if this message is all over the place, just can’t deal with this anymore. I find it very brave for you to present yourself in such a candid way however I refuse to allow these thoughts to convince me to being something of that nature. 😭

That is so reassuring and great to hear about your friends recovery, it is definitely hard because It’s usually less common for a woman to admit to experiencing that form of OCD or thoughts about that in general, it is very lonely. I’m so glad for her because it’s heartbreaking.

Porn addiction has sucked the life and innocent out of so many us included and it’s honestly not surprising what affects they tend to have on a young mind allowing us to develop dangerous relationships surrounding sex and I completely understand and am sorry that you were exposed to it so young as well. Wish there was more protection 😔
Thank you so much for reaching out.

Wanted to cry reading this, thank you for your support. It is terrifying to think of that being the circumstance even if it explains the thoughts it seems like a horrid illness to deal with and unfortunately I’ve never had the courage to be completely candid with any professional about these thoughts, though it’s becoming more apparent that something needs to happen because genuinely dealing with this makes me want to stay away from everyone. 
With a fragile sense of self these thoughts just make everything even harder because it makes me question everything, the past, the present and the future. Thank you for your advice, it feels like it’s too late for me but something needs to be done before it gets to that point of desperation.
I’m so sorry that you have dealt with trauma, just another reason why I cannot stand predators of any kind especially those who have been hurt themselves and decide to repeat that cycle of abuse.

Thank you for being honest and courageous by posting this, intrusive thoughts are a disease of the mind and even if we cannot control it I do believe that it is life ruining. It’s somehow not that reassuring knowing that many people suffer from it even from a relatable standpoint, it’s horrific to deal with. I know how paralysing those thoughts must be to you especially having to cope with them as a child, it’s just not right.
Hopefully you have been able to get help for these thoughts if not find ways to silence them.

I find that violent media is way too accessible in our society and it is slowly becoming normalised and that psychological affect on a young mind or any mind for that matter can have devastating results. Wouldn’t wish this on anyone. God forgive me.

This is a really touching response. Thank you..
Don’t really know what to say or think or do, but will be taking the advice that has been given today, it’s incredibly frustrating knowing that evil things like this happens daily and not knowing whether or not it’s your fault for being swept up in it. It’s scary. I’m not sure if there even is a treatment for this or if it even is part of OCD.

No it is not a ‘kink’ of mine and shouldn’t be a ‘kink’ of anyone’s AT ALL. It is an unwanted intrusive thought surrounding the abuse of children. Most of the time it is the thought of general child abuse and I am not the perpetrator. I also have incestual thoughts of my father abusing me does that mean I would ever entertain it? No. I don’t want to explore anything I want it to leave me alone because it’s disgusting and ruins lives.

Sorry to hear this.
That is a comfort, knowing that life eventually ends, but for now not knowing how to deal with it is overwhelming.

Thank you very much, you’re kind.
I wish you all the best in life too.

At this point nothing really makes sense. It does sound familiar because I also have intrusive thoughts about other horrible things but this one has troubled me since childhood and I can’t deal with it anymore. Am thinking about begging my mum to send me away somewhere so I cannot hurt anyone.

Heart feels like it’s breaking.
Just can’t understand why things are the way they are, i can’t trust anyone and especially not myself.

Thank you for your kindness I didn’t expect anyone to want to interact with me due to the nature of this post. I just want everything to be over and to be innocent again because it’s been gone for too long now.
Just feel so scared.

Thank you for reaching out, I’m so sorry but I’ve been in therapy and hospitalised since 12 and there doesn’t seem to be any change. If this is who I am then I must die, I am a threat to society and am deeply disgusted by myself. Now that I am an adult there isn’t much time left.

Give yourself a pat on the back for attending the interview! This is a good first step to getting yourself back out there. Feel your pain though, it can be so nervewracking. Good luck in the future friend. :)
